_about: Card text layout rules, read by BOTH the PC worker (worker/render.py stamps the card with Pillow) and the website (lib/text/layout.ts: Settings live preview + slider ranges). Fractions are of the card width W or height H; sizes are px on a 1080 px wide card and scale with W/1080. The name never wraps: it shrinks to fit maxWidthCenter (centred) or maxWidthSide (left/right). The meaning first shrinks to meaningShrinkFirst of its size on one line, then wraps onto up to meaningMaxLines balanced lines, then shrinks further. Change a number here and both sides follow.
